tasks.description: The export button should be added to the sales report page. It should be visible and clickable, initiating the download of the currently displayed report.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user clicks the 'Export to CSV' button, then a download of the current report is initiated.

tasks.description: Create a backend endpoint that generates the CSV for the requested report and streams the response to the client. This should handle large reports efficiently without buffering the entire file in memory.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large sales report, when the export endpoint is called, then the response is streamed to the client without running out of memory.

tasks.description: Allow the user to choose which columns to include in the export before downloading. The generated CSV should include only the selected columns, in the displayed order.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user selects specific columns, then only those columns are included in the exported CSV.

tasks.description: Encode the CSV per RFC 4180: quote fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, and escape embedded double quotes by doubling them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with special characters, when the CSV is generated, then the special characters are properly escaped according to RFC 4180.

tasks.description: The first row of the CSV should contain the human-readable column names for the selected columns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with selected columns, when the CSV is generated, then the first row contains the human-readable column names.

tasks.description: The export button should call the streaming export endpoint and initiate the download of the CSV file.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user clicks the 'Export to CSV' button, then the streaming export endpoint is called and the CSV file is downloaded.

tasks.description: Verify that the CSV export works correctly, including column selection, RFC 4180 escaping, and header row.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with various data, when the CSV is exported, then the resulting CSV file is correct and opens cleanly in common spreadsheet applications.
